% Pattern: kind/untitled. An environment with an empty title, numbered
% within the theorems, holds the claims of a proof. A proof proves each
% one, so each is a statement. A wrapper of the paper sets \thethm to its
% argument for one use, and that does not change the numbers of the paper.
% Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want thm-1 statement/theorem 1.1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=thm-1
% want stat-1 statement 1.1.1 status=here
% want proof-2 proof - proves=stat-1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{thm}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{stat}{}[thm]
\newenvironment{namedthm}[1]
    {\def\thethm{#1}\begin{thm}}
    {\end{thm}}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{thm}
A statement.
\end{thm}
\begin{proof}
A step.
\begin{stat}
A claim.
\end{stat}
\begin{proof}
A sub step.
\end{proof}
\end{proof}
\end{document}
